VBO:0200608.summary: Devoted and watchful, Giant Schnoodles often want to join everyday family life and can be eager learners. This Giant Schnauzer–Standard Poodle cross may take time to trust unfamiliar people, particularly in Schnauzer backcross lines. Play, training and exercise can sit alongside relaxed time at home; size, coat and manner vary between breeding programs.
